College Football - Virginia at Florida State

The Florida State Seminoles host the Virginia Cavaliers at Doak Campbell Stadium. The Seminoles won, 34-7, over the Bears paced by running back Ousmane Kromah, while the Cavaliers won, 42-3, against the Blue Hens paced by quarterback Beau Pribula.

College Football - Arkansas at Texas AAndM

The Razorbacks (2-2) travel to Kyle Field to face the Aggies (2-2). In its last game, Arkansas beat Tulsa, 34-6, in Week 4 as they snapped a two-game skid, while Texas AAndM fell to LSU, 35-6, and seeks to snap a two-game skid of its own.

College Football - Eastern Washington at UC Davis

The UC Davis Aggies host the Eastern Washington Eagles at UC Davis Health Stadium. The Aggies lost, 62-22, to the Grizzlies and try to bounce back behind Treynor Cleeland, while the Eagles fell, 31-27, to the Mustangs and start quarterback Nate Bell.
